content_data.project_title: Real-Time Spatial Analytics Engine for Immersive Environments
content_data.project_description: Development of a high-performance analytics engine that processes user interaction data within AR/VR environments to generate predictive insights for content optimization and user behavior modeling.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1: Architecture & Prototyping (months 1-4), Phase 2: Core Development (months 5-10), Phase 3: Integration & Testing (months 11-14)
objectives: Reduce analytics query latency from current 8 seconds to under 500ms
Create developer SDK for third-party AR/VR integration
deliverables: Performance benchmarking report and optimization recommendations
Automated CI/CD pipeline with comprehensive test coverage above 85%
Technical architecture documentation and system design specifications
Real-time dashboard for visualizing immersive user behavior patterns
resources_needed: Performance testing tools and load simulation software
Licenses for Unity and Unreal Engine development environments
Cloud infrastructure budget for AWS/Azure services including managed Kubernetes
2 machine learning engineers specializing in real-time inference
